searchText: are we able to have a field drive what the data looks like? i'm not up on all the options in yaml, but something like: `/eth/v2/beacon/blocks/{block_id}` ``` { version: "identifier" data { //depends on version as to what this looks like } } ``` code wise seems like a simple solution, and is fairly future proof if we can structure it in some way like that I'd imagine that given they are different resources (due to the version in the path) they would have totally separate definitions. I think the idea is that all blocks/states would be available via /v2/ but the data format would be different depending on whether they were from before or after the Altair upgrade.
